description: Decide liveness and alert cooldown at exact boundaries

files.notes/mail/core/core-0001.yaml:
id: "core-0001"
class: "core.escalate"
urgency: "p0"
from: "liveness checker"
to: "core"
summary: "stale liveness: example.001-FOX age=31s interval=10s"
at: "2026-01-01T00:00:31Z"
files.notes/mail/core/core-0002.yaml:

at: "2026-01-01T00:00:41Z"
files.notes/mail/example/example-0001.yaml:
id: "example-0001"
class: "spawner.decide"
urgency: "p0"
from: "liveness checker"
to: "example"
summary: "stale liveness: example.001-FOX age=31s interval=10s"
at: "2026-01-01T00:00:31Z"
files.notes/mail/example/example-0002.yaml:
id: "example-0002"
class: "spawner.decide"
urgency: "p0"
from: "liveness checker"
to: "example"
summary: "stale liveness: example.001-FOX age=41s interval=10s"
at: "2026-01-01T00:00:41Z"

expected.stdout:
stale liveness: example.001-FOX age=31s interval=10s
stale liveness: example.001-FOX age=40s interval=10s
stale liveness: example.001-FOX age=41s interval=10s

notes: Age 3× interval is live; one second later is stale. An alert is suppressed before the cooldown, emitted exactly at it, and a fresh heartbeat clears alert state.
